title: Everyday Notes & Daily Journal Data Cleaner
target_pain: Raw daily logs, voice dumps, notepad brain-dumps, and messy everyday notes are unstructured. Manually converting them into clean tasks, tag indexes, expense logs, structured Markdown, or JSON takes high friction manual effort.
key_features: Instant 100% local parsing of messy daily text, voice dumps, and bullet journals
Automatic extraction and categorization of Tasks, Expenses, Ideas, Metrics, Quotes, and Timestamps
Auto-indexing of all hashtags (#work, #ideas, #finance) and interactive tag filtering
Interactive status toggling for extracted todo list items
Export instantly to Clean Markdown format, Structured JSON schema, or CSV task sheets
Built-in local statistics including task completion rate and financial total breakdown
